book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Israel phungpaw taitah raering pehnah

Uny sahlo, Moses a zuipaw he aa ma pathlahtu sahlo cawh aa zongmingtei tah ma meding rai lekhei ung he ka, rili a lecingcing alui a rypaw lekhei aa seichua tahpaw bia heh a cingkai thlang la, tah ka du.
Aaning sahlo cawh Moses zui pawtah ma meding le rili lekhei baptisma a cang he.
Aa zongmingtei tah a lopaw thlawpaw lang batui khah e he ka,
a lopaw thlawpaw lang tui khah aa ding, aaning khatei a seilai hrahpaw thlawpaw lang alung puino taiteipaw tui khah ding he ka, ma alung puino cawh Khri khah a cang.
A cang naná teitah aaning letei mehlu vy sahlo khakhei Khazing cawh a lung tling be, macawtaco sadi raang lekhei a thi he.
Aaning sahlo tei aa tuapaw hratah chahlynah hming letei kaa thinglung kaa chia ly nápawtah ma hming sahlo heh a mingpai rua tah a ungpaw a cang.

Capathai letei, “Aaning sahlo cawh ding e rua pawtah khei a ty he ka, a nawngse rua pawtah khei a daw he,” tatah ciapaw hratah aaning sahlo letei thaikhehpaw sahlo tah nono a behpaw hratah naa cang ruapaw cang be.
Aaning sahlo letei thaikhehpaw sahlo tah canu capaw suanah tua he ka, ningkheh letah 23000 aa thihpaw hratah canu capaw suanah kaa tua ruapaw cang be.
Aaning sahlo letei thaikhehpaw sahlo tah Abuipaw
khah hnehsah he ka, pari tah a cuh sehpaw he hratah Abuipaw cawh kaa hnehsápaw cang be.
Taico aaning sahlo letei thaikhehpaw sahlo cawh phingze he ka, rawhrangtu vaiming tah a thawpaw he hratah phingze khe lo.
Aaning sahlo khatah ma hming sahlo a tlungpaw heh caichangnah letei a ungpaw kaaning sahlo kaa cawtah a mingpai rua pawtah le a raering nápaw cawtah ciapaw a cang he.
Macawtaco zingnah letah cyky tah ka daw thlang tatah a rawhpaw taco, suanah letah a po sua ly nápawtah khei a raering seh.

Tuhsonah naa cung letei a tlungpaw heh ming hringpaw zong tah aa ing cypaw khah a cang. Taico, Khazing cawh zingchuipaw a cang, naa ing khypaw a khunglang tah tuhso ruapaw takhei co ca sai bei he. Canghrasala tuhso naa ing tihtah naa ing khy nápawtah thawzaang ca pei he ka, chuathlahnah langpui zong a ca tua pá he.
Hrihrangnah kawngchua le Abuipaw zairia
Macawtaco ka dopaw vesaw sahlo, nono behnah khah saisai my lo.
A lungsingpaw cawngsaw biaching hratah ka ca ching he hi, ka reipaw heh achaw teitah pacang my lo.
A lawngbia a hlai hmotah bonghnang ny tei kaa dingpaw heh Khri thisai kaa hrongpaw he peh cang bei maw? Taico, very khah kychy peh ka, kaa epaw khah Khri a pung kaa hrongpaw he peh cang bei maw?
Kaaning mehlupui cawh pungkheh ka cang he peh, zemaw tah pawco, very cawh tlangkheh cy ung ka, ma cawh kaa hrongnah caw he peh tah a cang.
Israel cawngsaw khah pacang tua hmai o. Athuihlainah saw aa epaw sahlo khah dangnah siasang raihrenah lekhei a pahlawh hrah bei maw?
Ka rei dupaw cawh zemaw a cang? Nono khatah pehlaipaw dangnah cawh a puimaw maw? Nono cawh mai a hnuipaw a cang maw?
Cang be, canghrasala lawki cawngsaw sahlo tah dangnah aa tuapaw cawh khachia khatah cang ka, Khazing khatah cang be, khachia sahlo khatei a pahlawhpaw naa cangpaw heh du bei neh.
Abuipaw ny le khachia ny cawh ding pahrong khy bei ceh. Abuipaw a cabuai le khachia a cabuai letah e pahrong thai bei ceh.
Abuipaw a heitlia ná seh tatah zehmai kaa tua ruapaw cang be. Kaaning cawh ama navy tah chong vy bei peh.
Zingtu a cangpaw zalongnah

Thaikhehpaw tah, “Zezongpui tua heh sai a cang thlang,” aa tah, canghrasala, zezongpui heh chahnai thlu be. Thaikhehpaw tah, “Zezongpui tua heh sai a cang thlang,” aa tah. Canghrasala, zezongpui heh male a tuahrypaw cang be.
Ahohmai kaaning kaa cawtah chahnah khah hui lytah ming hringpaw chahnah khah kaa hui hripaw a cang.
Saw zuanah letei aa zuapaw maikaw cawh chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing rawng tah cakhia calia lytah e thlang,
zecawtamaw tatah, “Alui cawh Abuipaw a tei cang ka, a chung leteipaw maikaw heh a tei a cang he,” tatah Capathai tah a tah.

Zingtu a cang lypaw tah batui e ca hrui katei, na seipaw a cang caco, na hme letei a ca hungpaw khah cawh ze a cang zong tah na chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing rawng tah cakhia calia lytah lung pathai teitah e thlang.

Canghrasala, pakheh kheh tah, “Ma batui heh nono letah pehlaipaw batui a cang,” tatah a ca tah caco, ma tei a ca tahpaw cawngsawpaw a chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing a pathai nápaw cawtah e lytah ung thlang.
Nama na chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing cawtah cang lytah ama a cawtah tu a cang hri. Zecawtamaw kama ka zalongnah cawh ming hringpaw a chiachaw thluidangnah lungthing taco, biacepah a cang lalei a?
Lunglawng hmotah batui cawh ka e caco, zecawtamaw Khazing kha lawngbia ka hlaihnopaw batui rawng tahei suise ka cang a?
Macawtaco naa e tihtah cang seh, naa ding tihtah cang seh, hming naa tuapaw maikaw cawh Khazing a rungnawnah cawtah tua my lo.
Juda cawngsaw kha cang seh, Gental cawngsaw kha cang seh, Khazing a khrisawbu kha cang seh, a pachihly nápaw he zehmai chuakhui khe lo.

Kama tah ming maikaw a lawng nápaw he tah a phingphing tah ka zongpaw hratah a zawng hrah my lo. Zecawtamaw tatah kama cawh kama ka caw chahnah khah hui ly neh tah ming hlupui aa chah nápaw khah ka hui hri, ma pawsui co pachah aa cang khy a.

footnotes.text: Kih cai thaikheh tah Abuipaw tah ka, thaikheh tah Khri a tah.
